demonstrates: Built the submission layer eight research projects use on a shared Slurm GPU cluster: non-skippable preflight, a per-project budget enforced before and during a run, five triage conditions that reconcile the ledger against the cluster in both directions, and a ledger that traces any artifact back to the job, image and determinism declaration that produced it.
